correctness.rationale: Write z/o/t for numbers of labels 0/1/2 and w=o+2t. For max-degree-two paths/cycles, each zero needs two units of neighbor weight, giving 2z<=2w and t<=2w-n. For n odd this bounds twos by <=1 at minimum; for n even paths by <=2. For zero twos the zeros form an independent set (avoiding path endpoints), whose maximum independent subsets yield unique long odd-path minimizers, m binary even-path minima, two alternating even-cycle minima and n odd-cycle minima. For one 2, its support is forced next to the unique zero endpoint of an even path giving two reflected patterns; P3 adds 020, C3 adds three rotations of 200; on longer odd paths/Cycles one 2 cannot cover two required zero endpoints or adjacent zero pair. For two 2s equality forces the special P6 word 020020, no other even path. Hence exact leading coefficients: paths odd 1 except P3=2, paths even n/2+2 except P6=n/2+3; cycles C3=6, even >=4 gives 2, odd>=5 gives n. Independently enumerated every 3-state labeling for paths 1..9 and cycles 3..9, including P6 optimum=4,count=6 and C3 optimum=2,count=6. Finite tests corroborate this general proof, not replace it.
